description: Jobs — Fetch detailed information about a specific job, including full responsibilities, qualifications, and company details. Pass job_id from search_jobs when you have one. If the user asks for full details of a role without an id (e.g. the first software engineer job in Austin), pass query and optional location instead — the tool loads the first matching live listing.

job_id.description: The job ID from a previous search_jobs result when available.

location.description: Optional location substring when resolving details by query.

query.description: Role/title search used when job_id is missing (picks the first live match).

summary.description: If true, request first-time AI generation via GET /jobs/:id?summary=true. Default is raw plus cached AI only.

name: get_job_details
title: Jobs · Get Job Details
